# Gray Tile & Remodeling

> Tile contractor and home remodeler in Bowdon, Georgia, serving Carroll County and West Georgia.

## Business Information

**Business:** Gray Tile & Remodeling
**Category:** Tile contractor (Google Business Profile)
**Location:** Bowdon, GA 30108 (service-area business)
**Phone:** (404) 310-3381
**Email:** graytile@bellsouth.net
**Hours:** Mon–Thu 9am–5pm
**Website:** https://graytileremodeling.com/

## What the company does

Gray Tile & Remodeling installs custom tile showers, kitchen and bathroom remodels, flooring (tile, LVP, hardwood refinishing) and finished basements, and handles additions and structural work in-house. Estimates are free.

## Service area

Bowdon, Carrollton, Villa Rica, Bremen, Temple, Whitesburg, Roopville and the rest of Carroll County, GA; West Georgia by request.

## Frequently asked questions

**Q: What types of tile do you install?**

We work with ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, glass, and specialty tiles for kitchens, bathrooms, floors, showers, and accent walls. We can help you select the right material for your space and budget.

**Q: How long does a typical tile remodeling project take?**

Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. A bathroom remodel typically takes 2–4 weeks, while larger projects may take longer. We provide a detailed timeline during your consultation.

**Q: Do you handle removal of old tile?**

Yes, we manage complete tile removal and disposal as part of our remodeling service, including surface preparation to ensure proper installation of new tile.

**Q: Can you help with tile selection and design?**

Absolutely. Our design consultation service helps you choose the right tiles, colors, and layouts for your space — considering durability, style, maintenance, and your budget.

**Q: How do you ensure tile installations last in Georgia's humid climate?**

We use proper waterproofing, quality grout, and moisture barriers appropriate for Georgia's climate. Our installation methods prevent mold, mildew, and water damage for long-lasting results.
